//: EXAMPLE ONLY -- this file is inert where it sits. Managed settings are deployed by an administrator via MDM or the admin console to the OS-level managed-settings.json path; they are NOT read from .claude/. Copy what you need, do not symlink this.
//precedence: managed-settings.json > CLI flags > .claude/settings.local.json > .claude/settings.json > ~/.claude/settings.local.json > ~/.claude/settings.json. Deny rules win at every tier, so a deny here cannot be overridden by a developer's local settings. That is the entire point of this tier.
//scope: Use this tier only for what must not be negotiable: credential access, network egress, approval gates, minimum version. Everything else belongs in .claude/settings.json where the team can see and change it. A managed tier used for convenience settings is one nobody can debug.

permissions.//deny: Deny wins everywhere and cannot be relaxed downstream. Credential paths first: an agent that can read ~/.aws/credentials can act as the developer against production regardless of what else is blocked.
permissions.//allow: Pre-approve the inner loop, or the gates get clicked through reflexively and stop being read. Everything here is read-only or local-only.
permissions.//additionalDirectories: Empty by design. Each entry widens the blast radius to another tree the agent can edit.

//sandbox: OS-level filesystem and network isolation, enforced below the permission layer -- so a command that slips past a permission rule still cannot reach the network. Deny-by-default egress with an explicit allowlist is the shape that actually holds; an allowlist of blocked hosts does not.
//credentials: Strip credential material from the environment handed to spawned processes. Without this, a token in the parent shell is inherited by every command the agent runs.
//allowManagedHooksOnly: Only hooks defined in this managed file run. A developer cannot add a hook that bypasses an approval gate, and cannot disable one with disableAllHooks in their settings.local.json. Turning this on means the team's own hooks in .claude/settings.json stop running -- so either re-declare the ones you want here, or leave this false. It is the single most commonly misconfigured key in this file.
//requiredMinimumVersion: Refuse to start on an unapproved CLI version. Raise it deliberately after validating a release; a version floor nobody moves eventually blocks everyone.
//hooks: Approval gates live here so they cannot be edited away. A gate script exits 0 to allow, 2 to block -- and MUST write its reason to stderr, because a blocking hook's stdout is discarded and the user otherwise sees a refusal with no explanation.
